name: Bloody Mary
source:
The super-sadistic serial killer afterlife incarnation of Meimu, "Mary-Merry-Goround", summoned by the magical scissors "Phantasmagoria".
He possesses an immense amount of destructive force; he exterminates the Hell Prisoners as Bloody Mary, in hopes of venting even a part of that energy.
